reports.search: Filters the reports by what you type: the sender, the title, the text or the number.

filter.open: New reports nobody on the staff has taken yet.
filter.claimed: Reports a staff member took and is working on.
filter.resolved: Closed reports. They stay here for review and can be reopened.
filter.all: Every report: new, taken and closed.

col.id: The report number. The same number as on the website Reports page.
col.who: The player who sent the report, with its title under the name.
col.status: The report state: new, taken or closed.
col.by: The staff member who took the report.

reports.drawer: The report and its messages. What you write here shows on the website too, and reaches the player in chat when he is on.
reports.claim: Takes the report under your name, so the other staff see you are on it.
reports.resolve: Closes the report. The note you write is kept with it.
reports.reopen: Opens a closed report again, back among the new ones.
reports.against: The player the report is about, when it names one.
reports.thread: The report messages in order: the player and the staff, from the game and the website.
reports.reply: A written answer. It is kept with the report and reaches the player in chat when he is on.
reports.send: Sends the answer and adds it to the report messages.
reports.notes: A staff-only note kept with the report when it is closed. The player does not see it.

say.open: , and nobody has taken it yet.
say.offline: %s is not on the server now.
